=== Synergy Bonuses ===

==Strategy==
===Commander===
Galvatron has one of the most devastating attacks in both Ranged and Melee in the game. Dark Burns act like incineration (ie. instant damage), and bypass abilities that involve ''regular'' damage over time, like [[Grimlock]]'s Signature Ability and Wheeljack’s force shield. 

The only ways to charge up Dark Energy Charges are by Blocking at ranged distance (making sure to sidestep all heavies and retreat to charge) and Special III. Make sure you fully charge (30 charges), or else you lose the charges quickly. Dark Energy Charges allow for amped up Specials, Crits and especially Heavy Attacks.

His Special Attacks can do major damage when he has 30 charges. Special I can Stun and Specials II and III can both Dark Burn and do potentially fatal damage to the opponent... especially on Special III (those 60 charges!)

As if his skillset wasn't... ''crazy'' enough, dupe your Galvatron and you also gain the ability to become Unstoppable and gain passive Power on full charges.
===Opponent===
Anything that tampers with Ranged Attacks, like [[Blaster]]'s Interference and [[Scorponok]]'s Dazed, will almost likely hamper Galvatron's deadly Ranged Attacks. Prevent him from charging full charges by using Heavy attacks. If he gets to 30 charges, bait out his specials and dodge his Heavy Attacks, then counterattack shortly afterwards. He particularly loves using his Special I and Heavy attacks though he may not use his heavy attacks as often as [[Ramjet]] or [[Soundwave]] who spams them like crazy.

Unlike [[Megatron]] you can counterattack Galvatron while he is using his special ll and by doing that you either block or dodge his first hit and then strike quickly before he unleashes his second attack. Like [[Grimlock]], Galvatron also doesn’t know when to stop attacking with his melees when his opponent is dodging continuously even though he relies on ranged attacks so remember to keep your dodging skills in check!

Galvatron's Signature Ability can be troublesome as well. Bots with the possibly lowest health like [[Bumblebee]], [[Waspinator]] and other Scouts are not recommended and will have a harder time against the Master of Demolitions, making his enraging desire easier in order to finish the fight. [[Ratchet]] or [[Shockwave]] will be the best Will of Unicron counter as they can repair from the massive damage that Galvatron has dealt.

===Strong Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
*'''Anyone with armor, resistances or shields -''' Dark burns will bypass through them.
*Other bots who have low health.
*'''[[Starscream]]''' - You've seen it in the '86 movie, and it remains true here; the traitorous Decepticon Seeker remains no match for the Decepticon instrument of destruction. Starscream will immediately have nothing to nullify and his conoration will always be disrupted as Unicron's hand of chaos incinerates him alive.
*'''[[Ultra Magnus]] - '''Galvatron alternates between Physical and Energy Damage types, and can Dark Burn through them, making this Bot extremely hard for Ultra Magnus to adapt to. Clash of the new leaders begin.
* '''[[Grimlock]] - '''Grimlock will not have time to purify Galvatron's Dark Burn, making it one of the few Damaging Debuffs that can bypass the king lizard's signature ability.
* [[Cyclonus|'''Cyclonus''']] - Galvatron's second in command won't be able to nullify his unstoppable with his Dark Fields.
* '''[[Wheeljack]] -''' Despite the class type advantage Galvatron’s dark burns will bypass Wheeljack’s force shield. This also goes for other tech bots with shielding abilities which dark burns will 100% bypass through them though he wouldn’t be able to deal insane damage.
*'''[[Megatron]]''' - Galvatron has no buffs to steal and no armor to break which means, Megatron can’t use Galvatron’s strength against him.
*[[Megatron (ROTF)|'''Megatron (ROTF)''']] - Dark Burns will ignore Megatron's Armor and will ensure that nobody will hail him ever again.
*'''[[Megatronus]] -''' Galvatron's Dark Burn will bypass even the invsible Relic of Reservation effect and won't allow him to activate Relic of Immortality. Megatronus maybe the master of Demolition but Galavatron is the master of chaos, proving him to be the only true Demolition Master - not Megatronus at all.

==== Mods ====
* '''[[Security Module]]''' - Dark Burns will ignore the Armor boost.

===Weak Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
* '''[[Prowl]] - '''Keeping Galvatron’s power low is the best way to keep him from using his devastating Special Attacks.
* '''[[Ratchet]] - '''Galvatron’s signature ability requires the opponent to be at low health, something Ratchet is adept at preventing.
* [[Blaster|'''Blaster''']]''' - '''Decreasing ranged damage and healing from blocked ranged attacks will keep Blaster kicking Galvatron's tailpipe.
* '''[[Scorponok]]''' - Galvatron may be unhinged, but he won't be able to exert this power when Scorponok Dazes him.
*'''[[Bonecrusher]]''' - Galvatron will be especially punished on the last hit of Melee Combo.
* '''[[Soundwave]],''' '''[[Jetfire]]''' - Even their shields get bypassed easily by Dark Burns, they can still reflect while blocking Galvatron's ranged Attacks especially Heavies.

==== Mods ====
* '''[[E.M.I. Module]]''' - Facing a defender on this Module limits Galvatron's raw power... to a mere crawl. (Pair that with Blaster and he has tamed true insanity.)
*'''[[Paralyzer]]'''- Constantly draining Galvatrons power won't let him reach his full potential with his special attacks

===Recommended Modules===
Pair Galvatron with these Modules and add a touch of crazy to your Base!
* '''[[Strange Refractor]] - '''Galvatron must Block to channel Dark Energy; giving the master of Chaos the ability to Stun opponents when Blocking, and greater block damage from his greater block proficiency creates a deadly combination.
* '''[[Laser Guidance Module]] - '''The destructive potential of Galvatron's Ranged Attacks are unmatched by any other bot. Placing him on the Laser Guidance Module is a great way to stop raiders in their tracks.
* '''[[Robot Resource]]''' - Pair an Awakened Galvatron with this Module and he'll be all business when it comes to his strong Specials.
*'''[[Paralyzer]]''' - Many players seem to like to pair Galvatron with this mod. It really works as Galvatron can’t really stop attacking with his melees when his opponent is dodging continuously. With this mod, Galvatron can stun his opponents with his Special 1 and he will gain his own while his opponent get their’s drained away.
*[[Nightbird's Mark|'''Nightbird's Mark''']] - Like Jazz, Galvatron loves to crit a lot with Melee Attacks and this mod will make these attacks to be the most chaotic like bone-breaking opponents.

*[[Nightbird's Mark|'''Nightbird's Mark''']] - Like Jazz, Galvatron loves to crit a lot with Melee Attacks and this mod will make these attacks to be the most chaotic like bone-breaking opponents.
*[[Harm Accelerator]] - Not having a Bleed purifier is bad enough, plus facing the wrath of Unicron makes the situation to be double-edged.
